Every fix has a test failing on its prior commit.

data.rule: When a check stats paths taken from a human-written field (seen_in, sources), accept only one whitespace- and markup-free token (a whole markdown link as its target), count the rest in a note, and stat with os.stat so only ENOENT/ENOTDIR mean vanished -- Path.is_file raises on ENAMETOOLONG on 3.11-3.13 and returns False on 3.14.
data.title: A free-form 'source' field is prose until proven a path: parse it as one token or not at all, and never let a stat crash a report
